questions.question:
A Chocolate company prepares three different kinds of chocolate - X, Y and Z. The production of X, Y and Z over a period of five years has been expressed in the bar graph. The total production of Z in 2017 and 2018 is what percentage of the total production of X in 2020 and 2021?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4dc6e9e1e8603c966e62fbf5286ac4738a2676b4263f5b38032fc24e73c249b.png]
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

The total production of Z in 2017 and 2018 = 50579 + 44456 = 95035

The total production of X in 2020 and 2021 = 175128 + 157279 = 332407

Percentage = 95035/332407 × 100 = 28.59%

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: ΔPQR is a right angled triangle. ∠Q = 90 degree, PQ = 12 cm, QR = 5 cm. What is the value of cosec P + sec R?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠Q = 90 degree

PQ = 12 cm

QR = 5 cm

**Concept:**

Pythagorean theorem and Trigonometric identities for right-angled triangle

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9701e31967fa78c5c7c25301eeea8d1470c324290613b872a85c95179dc8d405.png] 

⇒ PR² = PQ² + QR²

⇒ PR2 = 122 + 52

⇒ PR2 = 144 + 25 = 169

⇒ PR = √169 = 13 cm

Now,

For the angle P, the perpendicular is QR and the base is PQ.

and, For the angle R, the perpendicular is PQ and the base is QR.

So,

cosec P = h/p = PR/QR = 13/5

sec R = h/b = PR/QR = 13/5

Thus, cosec P + sec R = 13/5 + 13/5 = 26/5

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**

questions.question: Radius of a circle is 10 cm. Distance of chord PQ from the centre is 8 cm. What is the length of chord PQ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius (r) = 10 cm

Perpendicular distance from center to chord (d) = 8 cm

**Concept:**

Length of the chord = 2 × √(r² - d²) for a circle 

**Solution:**

⇒ Length of chord PQ = 2 × √(10² - 8²) = 2√36 = 12 cm

**Therefore, the length of chord PQ is 12 cm.**

questions.question: If a - b = 8 and 4ab = 84, then what is the value of 3a³ - 3b³?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

a - b = 8

4ab = 84

**Concept:**

Cubic identities a³ - b³ = (a - b)(a² + ab + b²)

**Solution:**

⇒ 3a³ - 3b³ = 3(a³ - b³)

⇒ 3(a - b)(a² + ab + b²)

⇒ ab = 84/4 = 21 from given 4ab = 84

⇒ (a - b)² = a² + b² - 2ab

⇒ 8² = a2 + b2 - 2 × 21

⇒ 64 = a2 + b2 - 42

⇒ a2 + b2 = 64 + 42

⇒ a2 + b2 = 106

⇒ 3(a - b)(a² + ab + b²) = 3 × 8 × (106 + 21) = 3048

**Therefore, the value of 3a³ - 3b³ is 3048.**

questions.question: A certain number of persons can complete a work in 90 days. If there be 10 persons less, it would have taken 10 days more for the work to be completed. Find the total number of persons in the beginning.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by certain number of persons = 90 days

Difference in days if 10 persons less = 10 days

**Concept:**

Work is inversely proportional to time

**Solution:**

⇒ Let original number of persons be x

⇒ Work done is same, so x*90 = (x-10)*100

⇒ 90x = 100x - 1000

⇒ x = 100

**Therefore, the total number of persons in the beginning was 100.**

questions.question: The ratio of two numbers is 3 ∶ 8 and their sum is 88. What is the value of the smaller number?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of two numbers = 3:8

Sum of the numbers = 88

**Concept:**

The sum of numbers in the ratio

**Solution:**

⇒ Let the two numbers be 3x and 8x

⇒ 3x + 8x = 88

⇒ x = 8

**Therefore, the smaller number is 3x = 3 × 8 = 24.**

questions.question: A is a point outside of a circle with centre O. AP and AQ are two tangents of the circle. If AP = a² + 14 and AQ = 239, then what is the value of a ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of AP = a² + 14

Length of AQ = 239

**Concept:**

Tangents drawn from an external point to a circle are equal

**Solution:**

⇒ AP = AQ

⇒ a² + 14 = 239

⇒ a² = 225

⇒ a = 15

**Therefore, the value of a is 15.**

questions.question: Marked price of a chair is Rs. 1600. After giving two successive discounts of 10 percent and x percent, the chair is sold for Rs. 1368. What is the value of x?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Price after 10% discount on ₹1600 = 1600 × 0.9 = ₹1440

Value of second discount (x%) = 1440 − 1368 = ₹72

Second discount percentage = (72 ÷ 1440) × 100 = 5%

**∴ The correct answer is 5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) = ₹1600

Successive discounts = 10% and x%

Selling Price (SP) = ₹1368

**Formula Used:**

SP = MP × (1 − D₁/100) × (1 − D₂/100)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c465538410ec39a87019155d8e765a4bc5c65588b185fe5619169ab6d90b72f0.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Price after 1st discount of 10% = 1600 − (10% of 1600)

⇒ Price after 1st discount = 1600 − 160 = ₹1440

⇒ Selling price after 2ⁿd discount = ₹1368

⇒ Amount of 2ⁿd discount = 1440 − 1368 = ₹72

⇒ Discount percentage (x) = (Discount Amount ÷ Price before discount) × 100

⇒ x = (72 ÷ 1440) × 100

⇒ x = 5

**∴ The correct answer is 5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discounts

When two discounts d₁% and d₂% are given one after another, the effective discount is (d₁ + d₂ − d₁×d₂/100)%.

Marked Price & Selling Price

Selling Price is calculated on the Marked Price after deducting the discount: SP = MP × (1 − Discount/100).

questions.question: If the price of a product is first increased by 15% and then decreased by 20%, then what is the percent change in the price?
questions.solution:
**Given Data:**

Initial increase: 15%

Later decrease: 20%

**Concept:**

Calculation of successive percentage changes.

**Calculation:**

 Let the initial price be 100.

After increase of 15%, price becomes 115.

After decrease of 20%, price becomes 0.8 × 115 = 92.

questions.question: The ratio between the speeds of two cars is 5 ∶ 7. If the first car runs 200 km in 4 hours, then what is the speed of second car?
questions.solution:
**Given Data:**

Speed ratio of two cars: 5 ∶ 7

Distance covered by the first car: 200 km

Time taken by the first car: 4 hours

**Concept:**

Ratio of speeds and calculation of speed.

**Calculation:**

⇒ The speed of the first car = 200 km / 4 hours = 50 km/h.

⇒ If speed ratio is 5 ∶ 7, then the speed of second car is 7/5 × speed of first car.

⇒ Speed of second car = 7/5 × 50 km/h = 70 km/h.

**Therefore, the speed of the second car is 70 km/h.**

questions.question: The average weight of R, P and K is 40 kg. If the average weight of P and K is 45 kg and average weight of R and K is 35 kg, then what is the weight of K ?
questions.solution:

Average weight of P, K and R = 40 kg

Total weight of all together = P + K + R = 40 × 3 = 120 ----(i)

Average weight of P and K be 45 and K and R be 35 kg

P + K = 45 × 2 = 90 ----(ii)

K+ R = 35 × 2 = 70 ----(iii)

On solving eq. (i) and (ii)

Weight of R = 30

Then from eq. (iii)

⇒ K + 30 = 70

⇒ K = 40

∴ Weight of K is 40 kg

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: If the areas of two similar triangles are in the ratio 36 ∶ 121, then what is the ratio of their corresponding sides?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

When two triangles are similar, their respective sides are in same ratio.

Also, (ratio of areas of triangles) = (Ratio of respective sides)2

Given, the ratio of areas of two similar triangles is 36 : 121

∴(Ratio of respective sides)2= 36 : 121

Taking square root, we get

⇒ (Ratio of respective sides)= 6 : 11

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: What is the length of circumference of a circle with centre O and diameter 9.8 mm ?
questions.solution:
Given:

Diameter of circle = 9.8 mm

Concept:

Circumference = 2 × (22/7) × r [∵ r = radius of circle]

Calculation:

Let, radius of circle = r mm

According to the questions,

⇒ 2 × r = 9.8

⇒ r = 4.9

∴ Circumference = 2 × (22/7) × 4.9 = 9.8 mm

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: What will be the difference between the interest on a sum of Rs. 2,000 at 7% per annum for 3 years and that on a sum of Rs. 3,200 at 6% per annum for 2 years?
questions.solution:
**Given Data:**

Principal amount 1: Rs. 2000

Interest rate 1: 7% per annum

Time period 1: 3 years

Principal amount 2: Rs. 3200

Interest rate 2: 6% per annum

Time period 2: 2 years

**Concept:**

Simple interest calculation.

**Calculation:**

⇒ Simple Interest 1 = P1 × r1 × t1 / 100 = 2000 × 7 × 3 / 100 = Rs. 420

⇒ Simple Interest 2 = P2 × r2 × t2 / 100 = 3200 × 6 × 2 / 100 = Rs. 384

⇒ Difference = |Simple Interest 1 - Simple Interest 2| = |420 - 384| = Rs. 36

**Hence, the difference between the interests is Rs. 36.**
